Datasets.title: Animal/Non-Animal Stimuli (PNAS 2007)
Datasets.description: 1,200 natural images for animal versus non-animal categorization, from Serre, Oliva & Poggio (PNAS 2007). Hosted on Hugging Face.

Datasets.title: ClickMe
Datasets.description: Human annotations of the image regions used to recognize objects, for evaluating agreement between vision models and people.

Datasets.title: HMDB51: Human Motion Database
Datasets.description: The Human Motion Database: 6,849 video clips covering 51 action categories.

Datasets.title: The Breakfast Actions Dataset
Datasets.description: Videos of breakfast preparation by 52 people in 18 kitchens, with about 77 hours of footage and more than four million frames.

Datasets.title: Multi-Cue Boundary Detection Dataset
Datasets.description: Color stereo video sequences for studying boundary detection with multiple visual cues.

Demos and tutorials.title: ObjectLENS
Demos and tutorials.description: Explore the visual features and image regions that contribute to an ImageNet model’s predictions.

Demos and tutorials.title: LeafLENS
Demos and tutorials.description: Explore how vision models identify plant families from leaf structure and which features inform their predictions.

Demos and tutorials.title: hGRU Tutorials
Demos and tutorials.description: Notebooks introducing the horizontal gated recurrent unit (hGRU), a model of recurrent visual processing.

Demos and tutorials.title: Panoptic segmentation with hGRU
Demos and tutorials.description: A Colab notebook demonstrating how hGRU models segment objects and background regions in images.

Demos and tutorials.title: Horama starter notebook
Demos and tutorials.description: A Colab notebook introducing feature visualization with Horama.

Tools and software.title: Harmonization
Tools and software.description: Training methods that align a model’s visual evidence with human annotations from ClickMe.

Tools and software.title: Xplique
Tools and software.description: An open-source toolbox for explaining deep learning predictions through feature attribution and concept analysis.

Tools and software.title: Horama
Tools and software.description: Python/PyTorch tools for feature visualization, including MACO, Fourier visualization, and feature accentuation.

Tools and software.title: Neuroscience feedback models (PyTorch)
Tools and software.description: PyTorch implementations of neuroscience-inspired models of visual processing and feedback.

Tools and software.title: Compositional Visual Relations (CVR)
Tools and software.description: Code and dataset generators for the Compositional Visual Relations benchmark, which tests how models combine visual concepts.

Videos and talks.title: CVPR 2026 Keynote: Scaling laws vs. neural laws
Videos and talks.description: Thomas Serre’s CVPR 2026 keynote on scaling laws, biological vision, and brain-inspired learning and recurrent architectures.

Videos and talks.title: Vision beyond ImageNet
Videos and talks.description: A talk on visual recognition and what computational models can tell us about its neural mechanisms.

Videos and talks.title: Aligning deep networks with human vision
Videos and talks.description: A talk on architectures, visual experience, and training objectives for models that better match human vision.

Videos and talks.title: Aligning deep networks with primate vision
Videos and talks.description: A talk on comparing deep neural networks with primate vision and improving their agreement with biological visual systems.

Videos and talks.title: Feedforward and feedback processes in visual reasoning
Videos and talks.description: A talk on the roles of feedforward and recurrent processing in biological and artificial visual reasoning.
